description: The plot illustrates the maximum activation value of the attention output gate across different layers. The x-axis, labeled "Layer", has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 20 with a tick label interval of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Max Activation Value", also has a linear scale, spanning from 0 to 400 with a tick label interval of 50. Four lines are depicted in the plot: "attn_output" (blue dashed line), "attn_residual" (orange dotted line), "ffn_residual" (red solid line), and a gray line that is not labeled in the legend. The "attn_output" line starts at around 5 at layer 0 and remains relatively steady until layer 20, where it increases to approximately 120. The "attn_residual" line begins at around 10 at layer 0 and remains steady until layer 18, after which it rises to about 250 at layer 24. The "ffn_residual" line commences at around 10 at layer 0, gradually increases to about 50 at layer 16, and then sharply rises to around 380 at layer 24. The unlabeled gray line is mostly obscured by the other lines but appears to be largely overlapping with the "ffn_residual" line.
